author: ababushk
title: EasyOCR model download fails with HTTP 504 Gateway Time-out in PyTorch Models tests
signature: HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out|External Service

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_easyocr.py::TestEasyOCRConvertModel::test_convert_model[CPU-detector] and [CPU-recognizer] fail downloading EasyOCR model weights.

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the PyTorch Models tests job failed.

key_errors:
install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_easyocr.py:24: in load_model
    model = easyocr.Reader(["en"], quantize=False).detector
E   HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out

install/tests/model_hub_tests/models_hub_common/multiprocessing_utils.py:73: ProcessError
detector running failed:
...urlretrieve(url, zip_path, reporthook=reporthook)... HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out
root_cause: The EasyOCR test loads its detector/recognizer models by downloading them at test time from an external model-storage host via easyocr's own download_and_unzip/urlretrieve helper. That external host returned an HTTP 504 Gateway Time-out for both the detector and recognizer URLs, causing both parametrized test cases to fail. The PR under test (#38077) only touches .github/workflows/job_build_linux.yml artifact-upload gating and has no relationship to PyTorch model tests or EasyOCR; the failure is caused entirely by an unavailable/overloaded third-party download endpoint outside repository control, consistent with the same signature seen once before on 2026-07-09.
reproduction_steps: N/A (depends on transient availability of the external EasyOCR model-download endpoint at test time). Locally: run `pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_easyocr.py -k test_convert_model` and observe failure only if the remote host returns 5xx.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job/PR through the merge queue once the external EasyOCR model host recovers (handled automatically via remediate_transient_failure).

Consider caching EasyOCR model weights in the OpenVINO-controlled model cache/mirror (similar to the HF_HUB_CACHE mechanism already used for other models) to avoid depending on easyocr's own download path.
Add a retry/backoff wrapper around easyocr.Reader() initialization in test_easyocr.py so transient 5xx responses do not immediately fail the test.
prevention_strategies: Mirror or pre-cache third-party model weights (EasyOCR detector/recognizer) into the CI-controlled cache directory instead of relying on live downloads from the upstream host during test execution; add retry logic with backoff for external downloads in model_hub_tests.
historical_context: Identical signature (HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out | External Service) was previously recorded once on 2026-07-09 (run 29030218412, PR #36773). This is the 2nd occurrence; below the 3-in-12h recurring-escalation threshold.
